summary: Elderly woman startled by a rattlesnake fell and broke her wrist on Arthurs Rock Trail in Lory State Park; park rangers and Larimer County authorities were notified; litter-carried more than a mile down rocky trail to a trailhead ambulance, assisted by an off-duty Colorado National Guard captain hiking nearby.
location: Arthurs Rock Trail, Lory State Park
responding_agency: Lory State Park rangers; Larimer County authorities
notes: Source is an army.mil profile of Colorado National Guard Capt. Ronald Bailey, who assisted carrying the litter; rescue led by park rangers and Larimer County authorities; article published Aug 2, 2013; July 31, 2013 was a Wednesday.
